prompt: In which month and year did the COVID-19 toll across the world reach 1 million deaths, a number equivalent to the population of San Jose, California — the tenth largest city in the U.S. at that time?
answer:
The **worldwide COVID-19 death toll reached 1 million in September 2020**—reported around **September 28–29, 2020**.

*Note: The comparison to San Jose’s population specifically referred to the **United States reaching 1 million deaths in May 2022**, not the global milestone.*
